passage: We are ending the weekly all-hands meeting after attendance fell below half the company for three consecutive months. Beginning Friday, teams will receive a five-minute recorded update and a written decision log. A live company forum will run on the first Thursday of each month for questions and discussion. The first forum is October 3.

keyPoints.text: The weekly all-hands meeting is ending because attendance stayed below half the company.
It will be replaced by recorded updates and written decision logs.
A live question forum will run monthly starting October 3.

referenceAnswer: Weekly all-hands meetings will become recorded updates and decision logs, with a live forum monthly starting October 3.
